subject: design/solution-shape-v1
statement: The design and its shape are authored as a pair and reviewed in **one operator conversation**. The handoff names both repository paths and presents their exact source content, so the reviewer sees what freezes (the design) beside what stays live (the shape); nothing is transformed or invented. Approval is one gate over the pair; only the design's approval is a freezing event.
